functionalRequirement: In the Facebook settings menu, the system shall allow the user to delete their saved username and password for Facebook.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must completely remove all traces of saved Facebook credentials (username and password) from all storage locations when a user initiates the deletion action.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires complete deletion of saved credentials, necessitating thoroughness in the implementation.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The credential deletion option must be discoverable within the Facebook settings menu within 10 seconds by 95% of users during usability testing.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR specifies the deletion option should be in the Facebook settings menu, requiring easy discoverability.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must provide clear confirmation before and after credential deletion, with success/failure notifications visible for at least 3 seconds.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Users need feedback about the deletion process to understand the system state and confirm their action was completed.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The credential deletion process must require user authentication with a second factor (if enabled) or password re-entry before execution.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Since the FR involves deletion of security-sensitive information, additional verification is needed to prevent unauthorized deletion.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must log all credential deletion attempts (successful and failed) with timestamp, device information, and IP address, while preserving user anonymity in logs.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Security auditing is necessary for credential management operations to detect potential unauthorized access attempts.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The credential deletion function must complete successfully in 99.9% of attempts, with appropriate error handling and recovery mechanisms for failed attempts.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR implies a critical security function that must be highly reliable to maintain user trust and security.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The credential deletion process must complete within 2 seconds under normal operating conditions.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Quick response time is necessary for good user experience when performing security-related actions.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The credential deletion functionality must be implemented as a separate module with defined interfaces to facilitate future updates to authentication mechanisms.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Authentication systems frequently change, requiring the deletion functionality to be maintainable independently.

functionalRequirement: System shall request a deposit of Rs. 5000 upon entry of valid customer information and update it temporarily in the customer database.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must validate customer information against all required fields with 100% accuracy before proceeding with the deposit request.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR specifies that customer information must be valid before requesting a deposit, requiring complete validation.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must process the deposit request and update the customer database within 3 seconds of valid customer information entry for 95% of transactions.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Financial transactions require prompt processing to maintain good user experience and operational efficiency.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must support at least 100 concurrent deposit transactions without degradation in response time.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Financial systems need capacity to handle multiple simultaneous transactions, especially during peak usage periods.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must maintain 99.99% uptime for the deposit functionality during business hours (9 AM to 6 PM local time).
identifiedNFRs.justification: Financial transactions are critical operations requiring high availability to ensure customer satisfaction.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: In case of system failure during a deposit transaction, the system must roll back incomplete transactions and notify both the customer and system administrator within 1 minute.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Financial transactions must be atomic to prevent data inconsistencies and financial losses.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: All deposit transaction data must be encrypted using AES-256 during transmission and storage, with decryption limited to authorized personnel only.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Financial data requires strong protection due to its sensitive nature and potential for fraud.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must maintain an immutable audit trail of all deposit transactions, including timestamp, customer ID, amount, and status changes.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Financial transactions require comprehensive auditing for regulatory compliance and dispute resolution.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The deposit request interface must clearly indicate the required amount (Rs. 5000) and provide confirmation before processing the transaction.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Users need clear information about financial transactions to avoid errors and ensure informed consent.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The temporary database update mechanism must be implemented with a configurable retention period, initially set to 24 hours.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR specifies a temporary update, requiring a maintainable mechanism to manage the temporary state.

functionalRequirement: The system shall generate reports on storage consumption by financial contact.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system shall generate complete storage consumption reports that include all data types (documents, emails, attachments) for each financial contact with 100% coverage of stored items.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires comprehensive reporting on storage consumption, necessitating complete coverage of all storage data related to financial contacts.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system shall generate storage consumption reports for up to 10,000 financial contacts within 30 seconds.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Report generation for large datasets needs to be efficient to ensure usability in financial environments where timely information is critical.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system shall utilize no more than 500MB of memory when generating storage consumption reports regardless of the number of financial contacts being processed.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Resource utilization constraints ensure the system remains stable during report generation operations even with large datasets.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The storage consumption reports shall present information in both tabular and graphical formats, with options to sort and filter by contact name, storage size, file type, and date range.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The reporting functionality needs to provide flexible viewing options to support different user needs when analyzing storage consumption data.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system shall maintain 99.5% accuracy in storage consumption calculations, with clear indication of any estimation or approximation used in the reports.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Financial reporting requires high reliability in the calculations to ensure accurate decision-making based on the storage consumption data.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system shall restrict access to storage consumption reports based on user roles, with audit logs recording all report generation activities including user ID, timestamp, and report parameters.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Financial contact information is sensitive, requiring appropriate access controls and accountability measures for report generation activities.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The report generation module shall be implemented as a separate component with defined interfaces, allowing for updates to report formats without affecting the storage tracking functionality.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Modular design ensures that report formats and calculations can be modified independently as reporting requirements evolve over time.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system shall support export of storage consumption reports in at least three formats (PDF, CSV, and JSON) to facilitate integration with other financial analysis tools.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Export capabilities enhance the utility of the reports by enabling integration with other systems in the financial workflow.

functionalRequirement: The system shall be able to generate a series of multiple-choice fraction questions that form a cohesive storyline to introduce a specific topic.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system shall generate question sets that align with educational standards for fractions, covering at least 95% of the curriculum objectives for the target grade level.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires educational content generation, which must be appropriate and complete for the intended learning objectives around fractions.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system shall generate a cohesive storyline with 10 multiple-choice fraction questions within 5 seconds of request submission.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Quick generation is necessary for classroom use and to maintain engagement when teachers or students are waiting for content.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system shall provide an intuitive interface allowing educators to specify topic parameters (difficulty level, fraction operations, storyline theme) with no more than 5 input fields.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ease of configuration is essential for educators to effectively use the question generation feature without extensive training.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The generated questions shall use age-appropriate language and scenarios, with readability scores appropriate for the target grade level (±1 grade level).
identifiedNFRs.justification: The storyline aspect requires content that is engaging and understandable for the intended audience.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system shall generate mathematically accurate fraction questions with 100% correctness in calculations and answer options.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Educational content must be mathematically sound to avoid teaching incorrect concepts to students.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The question generation system shall use a modular architecture with separate components for storyline generation, fraction problem creation, and answer option generation to facilitate updates to any single aspect.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Educational content may need frequent updates based on curriculum changes or feedback, requiring a maintainable architecture.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system shall support at least 10 different storyline themes and be able to incorporate new themes through configuration rather than code changes.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The storyline aspect requires variety and adaptability to different educational contexts and student interests.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system shall sanitize all user inputs used in storyline generation to prevent injection attacks or inappropriate content generation.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Educational content for students requires strict content safety measures, especially when generating dynamic storylines.

functionalRequirement: System shall display a confirmation popup after the user fills out the form and clicks the submit button, saving the information to the database for further processing.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must successfully save 100% of valid form submissions to the database with all fields correctly mapped to database columns.
identifiedNFRs.justification: This ensures the core functionality of saving information to the database works correctly as specified in the FR.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The confirmation popup must appear within 300 milliseconds after the user clicks the submit button, regardless of database save operation completion.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Quick feedback is essential for good user experience when submitting forms, even if the background database operation is still in progress.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must complete the database save operation within 2 seconds for 95% of submissions under normal load conditions.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires saving information to the database, which needs to be performed efficiently to maintain system responsiveness.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The confirmation popup must clearly indicate the success status of the form submission using both color coding (green for success) and an appropriate icon.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Clear visual feedback helps users understand that their form submission was successful.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The confirmation popup must include a dismissible action (such as an 'OK' button or 'X' icon) that is at least 44x44 pixels in size for touch accessibility.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Users need a clear way to acknowledge and dismiss the confirmation, with sufficient target size for all input methods.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: If the database save operation fails, the system must retry the operation up to 3 times with a 2-second interval between attempts before showing an error message.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires saving to the database, and retry mechanisms improve reliability when temporary issues occur.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: All form data must be validated on both client and server sides before being saved to the database, with input sanitization to prevent SQL injection attacks.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Security validation is necessary when saving user-provided information to a database to prevent data breaches.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The confirmation popup component must be implemented as a reusable module that can be configured with different messages, icons, and action buttons.
identifiedNFRs.justification: A modular approach allows for easier maintenance and consistency across the application when confirmation popups are needed.

functionalRequirement: User will choose from options including searching for their issue, chatting with customer support, asking the community, emailing customer support, or calling customer support.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must present all five support options (search, chat, community, email, call) with 100% availability whenever the support interface is accessed.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR specifies that users should be able to choose from all these options, requiring complete functionality.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must load all support options within 1 second of the user navigating to the support page under normal network conditions.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Quick loading of support options is necessary for users seeking assistance, especially in potentially urgent situations.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Each support option must be represented with a distinctive icon and clear descriptive text that communicates its purpose and expected response time.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Clear visual and textual differentiation helps users select the most appropriate support channel for their needs.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The support options must be arranged in order of expected resolution time, from fastest (search) to slowest (email), to help users make informed choices.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Logical organization of options based on resolution time helps users select the most appropriate support method for their urgency level.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must display accurate availability status for each support option (e.g., chat hours, current wait times) that updates at least every 5 minutes.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Users need reliable information about support availability to make appropriate choices about which channel to use.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: When transitioning to any support option, the system must only pass the minimum required user information needed for that specific support channel.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Limiting data sharing between system components maintains user privacy while still enabling effective support.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: All support options must function correctly across desktop and mobile browsers, with the call option utilizing the device's native calling capabilities when available.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Support options need to work across different platforms to ensure all users can access help regardless of their device.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must allow administrators to enable, disable, or modify any of the five support options without requiring code changes or system restarts.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Support channels may need to be adjusted based on staffing, business hours, or other operational factors.

functionalRequirement: The system shall be able to grant edit permissions for assets to departmental administrators, inventory users, faculty users, and university users based on their department affiliation and authorization level.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The permission system must correctly assign edit permissions for 100% of assets based on all combinations of user roles (departmental administrators, inventory users, faculty users, and university users) and their respective department affiliations.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires comprehensive permission management across different user types and departments, necessitating complete functional coverage.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The permission granting process must complete within 500 milliseconds for 95% of requests, even when processing permission changes for up to 1000 assets simultaneously.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Permission management is a frequent operation that should not impede user workflow, requiring efficient processing.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The permission management interface must allow administrators to assign or modify permissions for multiple users or assets in a single operation, with no more than 3 clicks to complete common permission tasks.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR implies a need for efficient permission management by administrators, requiring an intuitive and streamlined interface.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must maintain an immutable audit log of all permission changes, recording the modifier, timestamp, affected assets, permission levels changed, and justification for at least 1 year.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Permission management involves security-critical operations that require accountability and traceability.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must validate all permission change requests against the requester's own authorization level, preventing users from granting permissions higher than their own access level.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR mentions authorization levels, implying a hierarchical security model that must be enforced.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The permission system must be implemented using a role-based access control (RBAC) architecture that allows new user types or permission levels to be added without modifying existing code.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR specifies multiple user types and authorization levels, suggesting a need for a flexible and maintainable permission structure.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The permission system must maintain consistency with 99.99% accuracy, ensuring that no permission conflicts exist across different user roles for the same asset.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves complex permission scenarios across different user types and departments, requiring high reliability in permission state management.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must support the addition of new department types or reorganization of existing departments without requiring system downtime or code changes.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR ties permissions to department affiliations, which may change over time in a university environment.

functionalRequirement: Texts sent to that number will be sent to the API, then the system will reply to the user with the answer as another text message.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must process incoming text messages and generate responses within 5 seconds for 95% of requests, and within 10 seconds for 99% of requests.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves real-time messaging which requires prompt responses to maintain conversation flow.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The text messaging system must maintain 99.9% uptime, with no more than 30 minutes of unplanned downtime per month.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR describes a communication channel that users will depend on for responses, requiring high availability.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must implement message queuing to ensure no text messages are lost during API processing delays or temporary outages.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR implies a need for reliable message handling between the text service and API.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: All text message content must be encrypted during transmission and storage using industry-standard encryption (minimum AES-256).
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves handling potentially sensitive user communications that require protection.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must be capable of handling at least 100 concurrent text message requests without degradation in response time.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR describes a service that could receive multiple messages simultaneously, requiring sufficient capacity.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Text message responses must be formatted to fit within standard SMS character limits (160 characters), with longer responses automatically split into sequential messages with clear continuation indicators.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves SMS communication which has inherent character limitations that affect usability.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must support text messaging protocols compatible with at least 99% of mobile carriers in the target market.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires broad compatibility with text messaging services to ensure all users can access the functionality.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The API integration must use a well-documented interface that allows for updating the underlying API without modifying the text messaging component.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR mentions API integration, which should be designed for maintainability and future changes.

functionalRequirement: After adding a transportation route, the user shall be able to retrieve transportation requests from other users.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system shall retrieve 100% of valid transportation requests that match the added route's parameters (location, time, capacity).
identifiedNFRs.justification: The core functionality requires complete retrieval of all relevant transportation requests to ensure the user has access to all potential matches.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system shall retrieve and display matching transportation requests within 2 seconds after a route is added, even during peak usage periods with up to 10,000 concurrent users.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Quick response time is essential for a transportation matching system where users expect immediate results after adding a route.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system shall present retrieved transportation requests in a prioritized list based on relevance (e.g., proximity, time match) with clear visual indicators for perfect matches versus partial matches.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Organizing transportation requests by relevance improves user experience by highlighting the most suitable matches first.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system shall maintain 99.9% uptime for the transportation request retrieval functionality, with scheduled maintenance occurring only during off-peak hours (2 AM - 4 AM local time).
identifiedNFRs.justification: High availability is critical for a transportation system where users depend on timely access to request information.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system shall only display non-sensitive information about other users' transportation requests until a formal connection is established, masking personal details like full names, exact addresses, and contact information.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Privacy protection is necessary when sharing transportation request information between users who haven't yet agreed to connect.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The transportation request retrieval functionality shall be implemented as a separate microservice with documented APIs to allow for independent scaling and updates without affecting the route creation functionality.
identifiedNFRs.justification: A modular design supports easier maintenance and updates to the request retrieval system without disrupting other system components.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system shall support retrieval of transportation requests across multiple platforms (web, iOS, Android) with consistent functionality and response times within 0.5 seconds of the primary platform.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Cross-platform adaptability ensures users can access transportation requests regardless of their device preference.

functionalRequirement: The Disputes System shall allow users to create charge back requests, prompting for required information and resulting in printed notifications sent to merchants if proof of disputed transactions is not provided.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system shall validate 100% of charge back request submissions for completeness, ensuring all required fields (transaction date, amount, merchant, reason code) are filled before submission is allowed.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Complete information collection is essential for processing valid charge back requests and meeting financial industry requirements.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system shall process and acknowledge receipt of a charge back request within 3 seconds of submission, and generate merchant notifications within 1 business day when proof is not provided.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Timely processing of disputes and notifications is critical for meeting regulatory timeframes and customer service expectations.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The charge back request form shall include contextual help for each field, with examples of acceptable inputs and clear error messages that suggest corrections when invalid data is entered.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Clear guidance reduces user errors and frustration when creating charge back requests, which can be complex for non-expert users.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system shall maintain a 99.95% success rate for generating and sending merchant notifications, with automated retry mechanisms that attempt delivery up to 3 times at 8-hour intervals before flagging for manual intervention.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Reliable notification delivery is essential to the dispute resolution process and compliance with financial regulations.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system shall encrypt all dispute data using AES-256 encryption at rest and TLS 1.3 in transit, with access controls limiting dispute details to the filing customer, assigned dispute handlers, and authorized merchant representatives.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Financial dispute information contains sensitive transaction details requiring strong security measures to prevent unauthorized access.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The Disputes System shall log all charge back request activities in a structured format that includes timestamps, user IDs, action types, and status changes to support auditing and troubleshooting.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Comprehensive logging facilitates analysis of the dispute process, helps identify system issues, and supports compliance requirements.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The notification system shall support multiple output formats (PDF, email, API calls to merchant systems) with the ability to add new notification channels without modifying the core dispute processing logic.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Adaptable notification methods ensure the system can accommodate different merchant preferences and evolving communication standards.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system shall implement dual verification for charge back requests exceeding $1,000, requiring supervisor approval before processing to prevent accidental or fraudulent high-value disputes.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Additional verification for high-value disputes reduces financial risk and protects both customers and merchants from potentially costly errors.

functionalRequirement: For any systematic action, such as disputes aging process, a case activity will be generated, and the user who initiated the dispute case must be notified upon next logon.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must generate case activities for 100% of systematic actions, with all required metadata including action type, timestamp, and associated dispute case ID.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires complete tracking of systematic actions through case activities, necessitating comprehensive data capture.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must generate case activities and queue notifications within 500 milliseconds of a systematic action occurring.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Timely generation of case activities is essential for maintaining accurate system state and ensuring notifications are available upon next logon.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Notifications must be displayed prominently upon user logon, with visual distinction from other system messages, and remain visible until acknowledged.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR specifies that users must be notified, which requires an effective notification mechanism that ensures users notice the information.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The notification system must maintain a 99.9% delivery rate for user notifications, with failed notifications being retried up to 3 times.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR mandates that users must be notified, which requires a highly reliable notification mechanism.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Case activity data and notifications must only be accessible to authorized users with appropriate permissions, enforced through role-based access controls.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Case activities may contain sensitive dispute information, requiring proper access controls to maintain data confidentiality.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The notification system must be implemented as a separate module with well-defined interfaces, allowing for future modifications without affecting the core dispute management functionality.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Separating the notification system enhances maintainability by isolating changes to this specific functionality.

functionalRequirement: System shall read initialization data to derive definitions of heating and cooling units.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must correctly interpret 100% of valid initialization data formats to derive accurate heating and cooling unit definitions.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires complete and correct interpretation of initialization data to properly define heating and cooling units.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must read and process initialization data within 2 seconds during system startup, regardless of the number of heating and cooling unit definitions (up to 10,000 units).
identifiedNFRs.justification: Efficient processing of initialization data is necessary to ensure timely system startup and availability.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must support at least 3 standard initialization data formats (e.g., JSON, XML, CSV) for defining heating and cooling units.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Supporting multiple data formats enhances interoperability with various data sources and existing systems.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must validate initialization data integrity and report specific errors for any corrupted or invalid data, continuing operation with default values where possible.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Robust handling of initialization data is essential for system reliability, especially during startup.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must log all initialization data processing activities with detailed information to facilitate troubleshooting of unit definition issues.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Comprehensive logging enhances the analyzability of initialization processes for maintenance purposes.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must allow for the addition of new heating and cooling unit types without requiring code changes, supporting extensibility through configuration.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The system should be adaptable to accommodate new types of heating and cooling units as they become available.

functionalRequirement: The website shall provide forms for certificates so users can request certificates online.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The certificate request forms must capture all required information for processing 100% of certificate types offered by the system.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires complete forms for certificate requests, necessitating comprehensive data collection.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The certificate request forms must achieve a task completion rate of at least 95% for first-time users without assistance.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Since the FR focuses on enabling users to request certificates online, the forms must be intuitive and easy to complete.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The certificate request forms must include clear error messages that help users correct input errors within 10 seconds of error occurrence.
identifiedNFRs.justification: User error protection is essential for forms to ensure successful certificate requests.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The certificate request forms must load within 2 seconds under normal network conditions (≥1Mbps connection).
identifiedNFRs.justification: Quick form loading is necessary for a responsive user experience when requesting certificates.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: All certificate request form data must be transmitted using TLS 1.3 or higher encryption.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Certificate requests likely contain personal information requiring protection during transmission.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The certificate request system must implement CAPTCHA or equivalent mechanisms to prevent automated form submissions.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Protection against automated attacks is necessary for a system handling certificate requests.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The certificate request system must maintain 99.5% uptime during business hours (8 AM to 8 PM local time).
identifiedNFRs.justification: Users need reliable access to certificate request functionality during typical usage hours.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The certificate request form system must allow administrators to add, modify, or remove form fields without requiring code changes.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The system needs to be adaptable to changing certificate requirements over time.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The certificate request forms must function correctly on the latest versions of Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Edge browsers.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Cross-browser compatibility ensures all users can access the certificate request functionality.

functionalRequirement: User shall be able to manage privacy settings such as who can view their profile, connections, and sharing data with third parties.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The privacy settings management interface must provide controls for 100% of the privacy-related features mentioned in the requirement (profile visibility, connections visibility, third-party data sharing).
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR explicitly requires comprehensive privacy management capabilities.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The privacy settings interface must be organized in logical groups with clear labels, allowing users to locate and modify any privacy setting within 30 seconds.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Effective privacy management requires an intuitive interface that makes settings easy to find and modify.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must provide immediate visual feedback when privacy settings are changed, and confirm successful application of changes within 2 seconds.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Users need clear confirmation that their privacy preferences have been successfully applied.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must enforce privacy settings with 100% accuracy, ensuring no unauthorized access to user data occurs when restrictions are in place.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The core purpose of privacy settings is to protect user data, requiring perfect enforcement.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: All changes to privacy settings must be logged with user ID, timestamp, setting changed, previous value, and new value for audit purposes.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Accountability for privacy setting changes is essential for security monitoring and issue resolution.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Privacy settings must persist correctly across system updates and must never reset to less private defaults without explicit user consent.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Privacy setting changes must be applied across all system components within 5 seconds of user confirmation.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Quick application of privacy settings is necessary to ensure immediate protection of user data.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The privacy settings system must be modular, allowing new privacy controls to be added without modifying existing functionality.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Privacy requirements evolve over time, requiring a flexible and extensible system architecture.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must support granular privacy controls that allow at least 5 levels of access permission (e.g., public, connections only, specific groups, specific individuals, private).
identifiedNFRs.justification: Flexible privacy management requires granular control options to meet diverse user preferences.

functionalRequirement: System shall set over temperature values to prevent temperature deviations beyond 3 degrees Fahrenheit.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must accurately detect and respond to temperature deviations with a precision of at least 0.1 degrees Fahrenheit.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires precise temperature monitoring and control to maintain within the 3-degree threshold.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must detect temperature deviations and apply corrective measures within 500 milliseconds of the temperature exceeding the threshold.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Quick response time is essential for effective temperature control to prevent exceeding the 3-degree deviation limit.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The temperature control system must maintain 99.99% uptime during operational hours to ensure continuous monitoring and prevention of temperature deviations.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR implies a critical control system that must be highly reliable to prevent temperature deviations.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must include fail-safe mechanisms that activate when temperature monitoring systems fail, defaulting to a safe operational mode.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Temperature control has safety implications, requiring fail-safe operation to prevent potential hazards from uncontrolled temperature deviations.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The temperature threshold values must be configurable by authorized maintenance personnel without requiring system restart or code changes.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The system may need adjustments to temperature thresholds over time, requiring maintainable configuration options.

functionalRequirement: System shall show the first lines of news articles based on the titles on the title screen.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must load and display the first lines of news articles within 1 second after title selection for 95% of user interactions.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Quick display of article previews is necessary for a responsive user experience when browsing news content.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must display article previews in a font size of at least 12pt with adequate contrast ratio (minimum 4.5:1) to ensure readability for users with varying visual abilities.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves displaying text content that must be easily readable by all users.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The article preview display must render correctly across all supported devices with screen sizes ranging from 320px to 1920px width.
identifiedNFRs.justification: News content display needs to work consistently across various devices users might employ to access the system.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must adapt the preview length based on available screen space, showing between 1-3 lines on mobile devices and 2-5 lines on desktop displays.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The preview display needs to adapt to different viewing contexts while maintaining usability.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: All personal details collected during account creation must be encrypted using AES-256 during transmission and storage, with passwords hashed using bcrypt with a work factor of at least 10.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves collection of personal information requiring strong security measures to protect user privacy.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The account creation module must implement a modular design with separate validation, user interface, and data persistence components that can be independently tested and updated.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Registration processes frequently require updates to accommodate new requirements, security measures, and integrations.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The account creation system must support internationalization for at least 40 languages and localization of all form fields, error messages, and help text.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Gmail is a global service requiring adaptability to different languages and regional requirements.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must implement rate limiting to prevent more than 5 account creation attempts from the same IP address within a 10-minute period to protect against automated account creation attacks.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Mass account creation poses operational risks requiring protective measures to ensure system safety.

functionalRequirement: A surface app page shall provide a customer with all customer system functionality.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The surface app page must include 100% of the defined customer system functionality with no missing features.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR explicitly requires 'all customer system functionality' to be provided, necessitating functional completeness.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The surface app page must organize functionality in a way that 90% of users can locate any specific feature within 30 seconds during usability testing.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Since the page provides 'all customer system functionality', effective organization is critical for users to find and access features.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The surface app page must maintain consistent UI patterns and terminology across all customer system functionality, with no more than 5% deviation from established design guidelines.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Consistency in UI patterns is essential when presenting multiple functionalities on a single page to ensure user understanding.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The surface app page must load all customer system functionality within 3 seconds on standard network connections (4G or better).
identifiedNFRs.justification: Loading all functionality requires efficient performance to maintain user engagement and satisfaction.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The surface app page must implement a modular architecture that allows adding or modifying individual customer system functionality without affecting other functions.
identifiedNFRs.justification: With multiple functionalities on a single page, modularity is essential for ongoing maintenance and updates.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The surface app page must adapt to display correctly on 99% of common device screen sizes from 320px to 1920px width without loss of functionality.
identifiedNFRs.justification: As a customer-facing interface, the page must be adaptable to various devices customers might use.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The surface app page must implement role-based access control to ensure customers can only access functionality they are authorized to use.
identifiedNFRs.justification: With all functionality available, proper security controls are needed to prevent unauthorized access to restricted features.

functionalRequirement: System shall display information and settings related to the required setting based on user input.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must display 100% of the relevant information and settings for any valid user input within the required setting context.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR specifies that the system must display information and settings related to required settings, necessitating complete coverage.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must respond to user input and display related settings within 500 milliseconds for 95% of interactions.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Quick response to user input is essential for a responsive interactive system that displays dynamic content.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must highlight or visually distinguish the most commonly accessed settings (top 20%) related to user input to improve findability.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Since the system displays settings based on user input, visual cues help users identify relevant options quickly.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must provide contextual help for at least 90% of displayed settings, accessible within one click or hover action.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Users may need assistance understanding the displayed settings, especially when they vary based on input.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must maintain accurate display of settings during 99.9% of user sessions, even when users rapidly change inputs.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The system must reliably show correct settings regardless of how quickly users change their inputs.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must implement a data-driven approach for mapping user inputs to displayed settings, allowing administrators to update relationships without code changes.
identifiedNFRs.justification: A maintainable approach is needed to manage the potentially complex relationships between user inputs and corresponding settings.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must support the addition of new setting types and related information with minimal configuration changes (less than 4 hours of development effort per new setting type).
identifiedNFRs.justification: As new settings may be added over time, the system should be flexible enough to accommodate them without significant rework.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must validate all user inputs for the required settings to prevent injection attacks, with 100% coverage of input validation checks.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Since the system responds to user input, proper validation is necessary to prevent security vulnerabilities.

functionalRequirement: If the validation fails, system shall prompt "Wrong OTP".

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Error Protection: The system must display the "Wrong OTP" error message in a clearly visible format (minimum font size 14pt, high contrast colors) that persists until user acknowledgment.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR specifies error feedback, which requires clear visibility and appropriate presentation to effectively communicate validation failures to users.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Self-descriptiveness: The "Wrong OTP" error message must be accompanied by instructions on how to resolve the issue (e.g., "Please check and re-enter the OTP or request a new one") in at least 90% of error cases.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR focuses on error notification, which should include guidance on resolution to improve user experience.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The system must display the "Wrong OTP" error message within 500 milliseconds of detecting validation failure.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves user interaction with immediate feedback requirements, necessitating prompt error notification.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Faultlessness: The system must correctly identify and report OTP validation failures with 99.99% accuracy.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR depends on accurate validation failure detection to provide appropriate error messages.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Integrity: The system must log all OTP validation failures with timestamps, masked user identifiers, and attempt counts while preventing log tampering.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves authentication processes that require security audit trails to track potential unauthorized access attempts.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Modifiability: The error message text "Wrong OTP" must be configurable through a centralized message repository without requiring code changes or system restarts.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR specifies exact message text, which may need to be modified for different contexts, languages, or policy changes.

functionalRequirement: Information on remaining job posting time and CV access shall be reportable

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The reporting system must include 100% of required data elements for job posting time (start date, end date, remaining days) and CV access (total views, unique views, download counts).
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires comprehensive reporting of specific information types, necessitating complete data coverage.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The system must generate reports on remaining job posting time and CV access within 3 seconds for standard reports and within 10 seconds for custom reports with multiple filtering criteria.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves reporting functionality that should provide timely information access for operational decision-making.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Capacity: The reporting system must support concurrent generation of at least 50 standard reports without degradation in performance.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR implies a reporting function that may be accessed by multiple users simultaneously, requiring sufficient capacity.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Appropriateness Recognizability: The reporting interface must clearly label remaining job posting time and CV access metrics with descriptive headers and include tooltips explaining each metric.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR focuses on information reporting that users need to easily recognize and understand.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Operability: The reporting system must provide filtering options for date ranges, job categories, and user roles, with no more than 3 clicks required to generate a customized report.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves reporting functionality that should be easy to operate and customize to different user needs.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Availability: The reporting system for job posting time and CV access must be available 99.5% of the time during business hours (8am-8pm local time).
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires consistent access to reporting functionality for operational monitoring.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Confidentiality: The reporting system must restrict access to CV access reports based on user roles, with only authorized recruiters and administrators able to view detailed CV access statistics.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves potentially sensitive recruitment data that requires appropriate access controls.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Reusability: The reporting components for job posting time and CV access must be implemented as reusable modules that can be integrated into different dashboard views and export formats (PDF, CSV, Excel).
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR specifies reporting capabilities that should be flexibly reused across different system contexts.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Adaptability: The reporting system must support the addition of new metrics related to job postings and CV access without requiring system redesign, accommodating at least 5 new metrics per year.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves reporting that will likely need to evolve with changing business requirements and additional data points.
